text: 得物更似鉴定撮合平台、消费者无权按三包法售后 买卖双方投诉高企且平台鉴别能力屡遭质疑
text_en: Dewu is more like an authentication and matchmaking platform, and consumers have no right to after-sales service under the three guarantees law; complaints from both buyers and sellers remain high and the platform's authentication capability has repeatedly been questioned
